endpoints.coordinateEvidenceDetail: nh_forest_society_contoocook_canoe_company_takeout_20260918 forest-society-contoocook-guide-company-takeout: The Forest Society's 2023 Contoocook guide explicitly identifies the Canoe Company as the one-way take-out and publishes 43.25013,-71.62135. This validates the managed access-area coordinate, not a surveyed wet-toe point. The company's current page describes its private river beach, paid shuttle service, and parking limited to renting or shuttle customers. Classify this as a conditional outfitter take-out, not unrestricted public parking; the published nine-mile itinerary does not establish shuttle coverage for longer upstream starts.
endpoints.note: Stored coordinate matches the named authoritative access-area control (nh_forest_society_contoocook_canoe_company_takeout_20260918 forest-society-contoocook-guide-company-takeout) on Contoocook River; access is conditional (Private outfitter beach; use only with a confirmed rental/shuttle reservation or explicit permission. Parking is for renting or shuttle customers only.), not unrestricted public access. This confirms the managed access area, not the exact water-edge point.
